blocks.text: Hillcrest Digital client onboard SOP

This is the working cut for HIL-SOP-2024-031 on June 13, 2024. Aisha Rahman asked for a written bound after the current path (Ad-hoc Notion plus Slack, mixed leftover from Harbor/Lakeshore) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Aisha Rahman, Sam Reid, and Keisha Ward. Primary host ops.hillcrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on onboard in a Slack thread with a password paste, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Checklist in this SOP. Staging host per client. Ticket prefix assigned. First publish is a window, not a Friday save. Secrets go through HIL-SOP-2024-038, not a paste. I am not restating a hallway yes. onboard in a Slack thread with a password paste is out because May client leftover: DNS login sat in Slack for 11 days. Aisha will not do that again. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at days=11, steps=14, clients=3, hours=2.6, weeks=1, prefixes=1, friday=0, paste=0. Sibling tickets HIL-2204 and HIL-TDD-2025-009. I will not reopen onboard in a Slack thread with a password paste in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Sam Reid is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Keisha Ward owns a leftover that is easy to skip: mail.hillcrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (47): refuse on onboard in a Slack thread with a password paste, lock is SOP checklist, staging host, ticket prefix, no Slack secrets. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HIL-2204.
If onboard is a Slack thread, we will lose the DNS login six weeks later.

What a skeptical user would try first on ops.hillcrest.internal: the path Aisha Rahman actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on onboard.hillcrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

blocks.text: Working notes a colleague can execute

Handoff leftover for this file: next owner inherits ops.hillcrest.internal, HIL-SOP-2024-031, and the last three working pages. Access that has to move is who can change onboard.hillcrest.internal and who can talk to the requester. If that is still me six weeks after pause, onboard failed. Sam Reid accepts in writing.

blocks.caption: Read-only. HIL-2204. ops.hillcrest.internal.
blocks.text:
# HIL-SOP-2024-031 read-only first
date -u
ssh ops.hillcrest.internal 'uptime; df -h | head'
kubectl -n hillcrest get pods -o wide | head
# stop. write the last error in one sentence on HIL-2204
# do not helm upgrade from a laptop in a freeze

items: Write the symptom on HIL-2204 before any write.
Confirm on ops.hillcrest.internal with the read-only commands above.
If the refuse on onboard in a Slack thread with a password paste is being reopened, stop and ping Aisha Rahman.
Wake Sam Reid only after a one-line diagnosis.
Do not apply from a laptop in a freeze.
